entities.name: Louisa Margaret Dunkley
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louisa Margaret Dunkley was an Australian telegraphist and labor organizer who successfully campaigned for the right for women to obtain equal pay for equal work in the Australian commonwealth public service.
